description_preview:

 formX is building an AI\-native platform that redefines how the built environment is designed and delivered.
 





 We are not layering AI onto existing workflows—we are rebuilding the system from first principles. Our platform combines generative models, agentic orchestration, and computational geometry to automate and optimize the full lifecycle of residential development—from concept generation to planning and execution.
 





 This is fundamentally a systems problem: transforming a fragmented, human\-driven process into a programmable, intelligent pipeline.
 





 We’re early, well\-positioned, and focused on building a category\-defining product.
 




  





**The Role** 




  






 We’re looking for an exceptional software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical problems and building intelligent systems that have real\-world impact.
 





 You will help build the computational core of FormX’s AI design and construction platform. Working at the intersection of AI, computational geometry, structural engineering, and automation, you will develop systems that transform architectural designs into buildable, fabrication\-ready structures—including structural assemblies, construction details, and engineering outputs.
 





 You will design AI agents that reason through design requirements, engineering constraints, code compliance, and optimization decisions, while collaborating closely with architecture, engineering, product, and software teams. You will also help define the long\-term technical architecture of a platform that automates significant portions of the design and construction processes.
